defs.def: to feel a continuous dull pain 疼痛；隐痛

ex.s: Though it is the only unnatural thing on your way up the mountain, still it highlights the whole adventure ___62___ offers a place where you can sit down to rest your ___63___ (ache) legs.
ex.t: 尽管它是你上山途中唯一不自然的东西，它仍然突显了整个冒险（第62空），并提供了一个你可以坐下来休息（第63空，ache）双腿的地方。

ex.s: It's a bit hot and sweaty inside the suit, and my legs ache, but it's a lot of fun.
ex.t: 宇航服里面有点热、有点出汗，我的腿也酸，但很有趣。

ex.s: Even a thirty-minute run will provide relief from aches or tension that you may be suffering due to stress.
ex.t: 即使是三十分钟的跑步，也能缓解你可能因压力而遭受的酸痛或紧张。

defs.def: to have a strong desire for sb/sth or to do sth 渴望

ex.s: My body ached all the time and thus I thought I didn’t have much longer to live.
ex.t: 我的身体一直在疼，于是我想我活不了多久了。

ex.s: Ivy recognised a(n) ___3___ feeling when Mia was applauded, and an ache in the heart when she compared herself with Mia.
ex.t: 当Mia受到掌声时，Ivy认出了一种___3___的感觉；而当她把自己和Mia比较时，心里一阵刺痛。
